title: Extract and Document VB6 Business Rules
problem_statement: Critical business logic embedded in VB6 forms without documentation, risking data contract violations during modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Loss of critical banking business rules leading to data integrity issues and regulatory compliance failures
suggested_approach: Systematic analysis of all VB6 forms to extract validation rules, business logic, and data flow patterns into documented specifications
success_criteria: Business logic extracted to specification documents

title: Implement Secure Authentication Framework
problem_statement: Legacy frmLogin form lacks modern security patterns, exposing banking application to authentication vulnerabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to banking functions, regulatory compliance violations, potential data breaches
suggested_approach: Replace VB6 login form with modern authentication service supporting MFA, session management, and audit logging
success_criteria: Audit logging for all authentication events

title: Database Schema Discovery and Documentation
problem_statement: Database structure unknown, preventing accurate data contract preservation during modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Data migration failures, broken relationships, loss of referential integrity
suggested_approach: Reverse engineer database schema from Data Environment and ADO connections, document all tables, relationships, and constraints

title: Refactor Python Agent Import Structure
problem_statement: Wildcard imports in agent framework reduce maintainability and increase coupling between components
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased technical debt, harder debugging, potential circular import issues
suggested_approach: Replace wildcard imports with explicit imports, add type hints, implement proper dependency injection
success_criteria: All wildcard imports replaced with explicit imports
Type hints added to all agent methods
Import cycle detection added to CI

title: Implement Transaction Audit and Rollback Mechanisms
problem_statement: Banking transaction forms lack visible audit trails and rollback capabilities required for financial applications
risk_if_unaddressed: Regulatory compliance violations, inability to trace transactions, data integrity issues
suggested_approach: Implement comprehensive transaction logging with ACID compliance and rollback capabilities
success_criteria: All transactions logged with full audit trail
